summary.text: Lian Ke Xin is a mermaid immortal, one of three female immortals leading Eastern Sea's Merman Imperial Court.

claims.text: At a grand banquet she sits on the main seats with Yu Zi and Xie Ning Si and entertains Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch. She thanks him for praising the dancing Gu Masters as the tribe’s Gu Immortal seeds. She answers that mermen have lived in Eastern Sea peacefully and will not be provoked into outside conflict. When he presses that Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable’s protection has faded, she has a grim expression and cannot rebuke him. He says the court has many Gu Immortals but not a single rank eight. After two lost rounds, Xie Ning Si suggests using “that.” Lian Ke Xin and Yu Zi refuse, saying the influence is too large and the tribe would be exterminated. She also denies asking Gu tribe’s leader for help: he is a beastman in seclusion, asking would make things difficult for him, and he might not win. When Yu Zi names a great expert at Gu tribe headquarters, Lian Ke Xin realizes who she means.

The three mermaids receive a letter and their faces glow with joy. Lian Ke Xin says they have invited someone to go against Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch. Wu Shuai enters after them. Dragon Palace blows apart the merman hall, and Di Zang Sheng is released. Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch admits defeat. Wu Shuai then says they should talk about the alliance, and the three mermaids are shocked.

The Merman Imperial Court has joined the two heavens alliance. Wu Shuai does not expose their identity. They are spies sent to gather information. Feeling a cold breeze in the sky, Lian Ke Xin calms down as sorrow emerges. Eastern Sea will be peaceful for a period, the calm before the storm. She has high status and authority, but she feels helpless and fearful. The chaos has just started, and if she is careless the entire court could be completely devoured.

Fang Yuan takes in six mermaid Gu Immortals, all female. The two strongest have rank seven cultivation, the other four rank six. Lian Ke Xin is the other leader beside Yu Zi. The court chose two of its three leading first supreme elders, who have rank seven battle strength, and four other mermaid immortals. Xie Ning Si is the third of those three leaders. Lian Ke Xin grasps Yu Zi’s hand and consoles her that Fang Yuan is still a man, and to think of Giant Sun Immortal Venerable. Tang Qiong’s status is lower than Yu Zi, Lian Ke Xin, and Xie Ning Si. After Fairy Miao Yin warns them in Star Collection City, Lian Ke Xin and Yu Zi transmit that she may know their intention and wants to suppress them.

Yu Zi and Lian Ke Xin look at the contribution board together. Sixth Hair stands first by a wide margin. Lian Ke Xin sees familiar names in the top ten, including Fairy Miao Yin, Lady White Rabbit, Mo Tan Sang, Xue Er, and Shi Shi Cheng. They notice Lang Ya land spirit on the board as well. As former rulers of the Merman Imperial Court they are pleased that the top ten are mostly variant human Gu Immortals. The exchange board shocks them: Immortal Gu, recipes, materials, killer moves, Immortal Gu House methods, and inheritances, including merfolk expert Third Princess. Their desire for contribution points rises. After Twelfth Hair explains the mission load, Lian Ke Xin and Yu Zi look at each other and understand Fang Yuan’s intention in bringing them in.

At Mini Eastern Sea she interrupts Twelfth Hair to say they saw everyone in the sovereign immortal aperture given equal chances, whether inkman, rockman, snowman, or human. She sighs that it is a wonderful place to live. She and Yu Zi exchange information path mortal Gu with him. After eight hundred thousand merfolk settle, Yu Zi stays to create the ecology. The four female immortals led by Lian Ke Xin go out to collect information and establish relationships. She spends a day reaching Yellow Hair Continent, brings a gift, and hears from Twelfth Hair that using missions to meet people is the local custom. They take a mission to nurture Gu Immortal seeds. In a mountain forest she inspects a mixed blood hairy man Gu Master, Gu Yue Fang Xiang. Her pupils contract and her entire body shudders. Twelfth Hair says he is not Fang Yuan’s bloodline, but the son of Gu Yue Fang Zheng, secretly nurtured as the most qualified hairy man Gu Immortal seed.

The mermaid sealed in white jade in a deep pool is Lian Ke Xin. She names herself mermaid immortal Lian Ke Xin, asks Gu Yue Fang Xiang to refine rank four earth refinement Gu, and gives him the recipe. After she “escapes,” she heals his injuries, gives him close to ten mortal Gu, and an immortal cultivation inheritance. He calls her Fairy Ke Xin and Fairy Lian Ke Xin. She flies into the clouds. Twelfth Hair hid nearby and helped the refinement succeed.

Within the clouds she meets Twelfth Hair secretly. She answers that Gu Yue Fang Xiang is a Gu Immortal seed with a high chance of becoming an immortal. She had taken the mission to get closer to Twelfth Hair. Once she learned Fang Xiang’s identity, she used herself as bait. She yields the distribution of contribution points to Twelfth Hair. When a rank seven Immortal Gu refinement aura rises, she guesses that the imprisoned Gu Immortal is Sixth Hair.

She comes across Yu Zi, tells her to go to Liver Life Hall immediately, and says she has just left it herself. Before they entered the sovereign immortal aperture they were leaders of the Merman Imperial Court. She is happy the aperture added black-yellow earth pool, and worried that abnormal situations will happen more often. She hopes for more companions, but says rashly bringing in the five regions’ Gu Immortals is not appropriate, both for spies and for racial equality. She has a mission to do and does not accompany Yu Zi inside.

The mermaid immortal Lian Ke Xin floats in the air beside Gu Yue Fang Xiang. Her eyes do not move. She stares at him fixedly. Balancing the three qi cannot be interrupted; otherwise she would rather do it for him. She took a mission board task to “accidentally” meet him and coax him to a place suitable for immortal ascension. Fang Yuan secretly opened the sovereign immortal aperture’s door to bring Gu Yue Fang Xiang to the five regions.

Among the merman female immortals in Mini Eastern Sea, Yu Zi is mostly in charge of completing missions and earning contribution points. Lian Ke Xin is in charge of external relations, communicating with the other races and forces. Tang Qiong is in charge of defending the merman tribe’s territory.

After Gu Yue Fang Xiang becomes a Gu Immortal, Lian Ke Xin has been helping him with his tribulation. She explains that to save his mother he needs contribution points under Great Love Immortal Venerable to issue a healing mission. She leads him to meet Twelfth Hair. When Twelfth Hair asks Fang Xiang to help arrange Floating Refinement Hive, she is surprised the hive has already been refined, and she warns that Fang Xiang has just become an immortal. She smiles and nods when he looks to her, then sets off to Refinement Sea with him. Under her guidance they start arranging the immortal formation. After three days they have only completed ten percent. She posts a mission. Ni Lao Shi, a newly advanced formation path Gu Immortal, accepts it. Three days later the arrangement is completed, and he takes a sum of contribution points from her.
